passedGroups: official hello and nine sync messages leave menu unchanged
failure: The driver exhausts at most five fixed-duration DOWN holds while the original O piece is still active, then asserts that A changes rotation. O has one orientation in the existing model, so this assertion requires a non-O precondition that was not achieved.
timingLimit: No frame-rate measurement was taken. Fixed wall-clock waits do not prove simulated progress; runtime clamps large frame deltas. The retained final snapshot directly proves no piece had locked.
recommendedChange: Drive DOWN through the unchanged SDK until lockedPieces increases and a non-null non-O piece is observed, release DOWN, then assert a real A rotation. Bound the wait with an explicit precondition timeout instead of continuing on an O piece.
additionalReview: For second-seat held-sync safety, wait for the matching connection/sequence ACK and a subsequent frame snapshot before asserting b=false. Merely observing a sent proxy message plus a changed session may precede server application.

visualReview.result: Controls and service address readable at both sizes; failure image visibly contains the still falling O piece. QR unavailable placeholder is expected in the synthetic native bridge.
